author: bannybalva
quote: This is the best gaming experience I have ever had. Its ACTUALLY fun! So many games are overwhelming and exhausting, but not this. Its pure fun. If you want to feel like a kid again, this is your game!
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: bannybalva
quote: Eye candy. Clunky mechanics. There's an astounding lack of freedom that you'd find in other gtas. I find myself getting exhausted playing this game.
